nodes.label: UAD — Unitat d'Avaluació i Diagnòstic
nodes.rationale: Built as a dedicated multidisciplinary evaluation unit (psychology, psychopedagogy, speech therapy) so a diagnosis is a shared understanding rather than a single test score, producing a usable report and concrete follow-up recommendations; coordinates internally with Pragma Clínic when clinical/psychiatric follow-up is needed, without the family repeating their story.

nodes.label: Procés d'avaluació UAD (6 passos)
nodes.rationale: Process is intentionally staged (first interview, evaluation, multidisciplinary analysis, diagnosis/conclusions, report, guidance/follow-up) so timelines and session counts are set per-case at the first interview rather than fixed in advance.
